# CANYO LLC

> Veteran-owned managed IT services provider serving small businesses in Tucson and Southern Arizona. Flat-rate monthly pricing with guaranteed response times.

## Company

- [About](https://canyo.net/about/): Founder Samuel Glenn, veteran-owned, our approach
- [Process](https://canyo.net/process/): assess, document, execute, verify
- [Services](https://canyo.net/services/): 24/7 monitoring, M365 management, backup & recovery, on-site support
- [Pricing](https://canyo.net/pricing/): $200/user up to 10 users; $2,000 base + $150/user beyond
- [FAQ](https://canyo.net/faq/): Common client questions
- [Contact](https://canyo.net/contact/): contact@canyo.net, +1-520-336-7521
